title: Docker Multi-Stage Build Optimization — Companion Files
title_es: Optimización de Multi-Stage Builds en Docker — Archivos complementarios
description: Runnable multi-stage Dockerfiles covering image-size and build-speed optimization: Node, Python on distroless via pip --target, Go on scratch, Gradle to JRE Alpine, Rust, a deps/test/build/production CI pipeline, BuildKit cache mounts, multi-arch buildx, a size-verification script, and a .dockerignore.
description_es: Dockerfiles multi-stage ejecutables para optimizar tamaño e velocidad de build: Node, Python en distroless con pip --target, Go en scratch, Gradle a JRE Alpine, Rust, un pipeline CI deps/test/build/production, cache mounts de BuildKit, buildx multi-arch, un script de verificación de tamaños y un .dockerignore.
